tools.name: search
tools.description: Describe what you want to do in natural language; returns the matching Data 360 tool families and tool names.

query.description: Natural-language intent, for example create and manage a segment.

tools.name: payload_examples

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Runs a named Data 360 tool through the Connect API. Tools can create, update and delete data, so confirm changes with the user first.

toolName.description: Name of the tool to invoke.

paramsJson.description: Tool parameters as a JSON string matching the tool schema.
